2607.23067.title: Attention-Guided Layer Selection for Contrastive Decoding in Large Language Models
2607.23067.paper_summary: Contrastive decoding methods such as DoLa improve the factuality of Large Language Models (LLMs) by contrasting the output distributions of mature and premature layers. However, DoLa's dynamic layer selection relies solely on divergences in output vocabulary distributions. In this work, we propose three attention-guided strategies: Attention-JSD, Attention-Entropy-Max, and Attention-Entropy-Min, which leverage structural information carried by internal self-attention mechanisms as a signal for layer selection. Experimental results on TruthfulQA demonstrate that our strategies, particularly Attention-JSD and Attention-Entropy-Min, consistently outperform the original DoLa. We observe significant gains on multi-answer metrics (MC2 and MC3), suggesting that attention distributions can provide a more sensitive signal for resolving factual knowledge than output vocabulary distributions.
2607.23067.paper_summary_zh: 對比解碼方法如 DoLa 通過對比成熟和不成熟層的輸出分佈來提高大型語言模型 (LLMs) 的事實性。<lb/>然而，DoLa 的動態層選擇僅依賴於輸出詞彙分佈的差異。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們提出了三種基於注意力的策略：Attention-JSD、Attention-Entropy-Max 和 Attention-Entropy-Min，這些策略利用內部自注意力機制所攜帶的結構信息作為層選擇的信號。<lb/>在 TruthfulQA 上的實驗結果顯示，我們的策略，特別是 Attention-JSD 和 Attention-Entropy-Min，始終優於原始的 DoLa。<lb/>我們觀察到在多答案指標 (MC2 和 MC3) 上有顯著的增益，這表明注意力分佈可以提供比輸出詞彙分佈更敏感的信號來解決事實知識問題。
